entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer, brother of Mishra, and Tocasia's apprentice; leader in the war against Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival in the brothers' war, a creator of war machines.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The brothers' original master, who led them in exploring Koilos.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's greatest assistant, promoted to master after creating clay warriors.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's lieutenant, feared by her troops and foes, inventor of torture techniques and the transmogrant.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Founder of the College of Lat-Nam, husband of Hurkyl.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife, who was the true author of a spell attributed to Drafna.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A college founded by Drafna whose Sages became adept in repairing broken artifacts.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A forest ravaged during the rule of the artificers; its spirits and Druids oppose devices.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city allied with Urza that was destroyed by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A sacred cave explored by the brothers with Tocasia.

entities.name: Hall of Tagsin
entities.description: Chamber in Koilos where the Mightstone and weakstone were found.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: A remarkable stone Urza discovered in the Hall of Tagsin.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: A mysterious stone Mishra discovered in the Hall of Tagsin.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Finder of the first of Feldon's canes, frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Deity who instilled a portion of her power into vengeful followers after Argoth's destruction.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A place Jarsyl entered, marked by warm rain of grease.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Diarist who entered Phyrexia.

entities.name: Dominia
entities.description: The world made a casualty of the war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Thraxodemon
entities.description: A being black mages could coax into inhabiting a magical device.

entities.name: Battle of Sarinth
entities.description: A battle where a handful of peasant-pikemen held off three Craw Wurms.

entities.name: Battle of Tomakul
entities.description: A battle that taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

entities.name: Su-Chi
entities.description: Flawed copies of Thran relics, used by Tocasia's students.

entities.name: Citanul Druids
entities.description: Druids driven mad by the fall of Argoth who found peace only in battle.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
events.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

events.summary: As children, Tocasia takes the brothers to Koilos, where Mishra discovers the weakstone.
Urza gives amulets to the healers of Kroog as a sign of friendship, drawing thousands to the city.
events.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

events.summary: Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at Urza's side, and Urza vows that his allies will never need to fear for their defense again.
events.quote: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again

events.summary: Tawnos creates clay warriors; Urza promotes him from apprentice to master.
events.quote: Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

events.summary: Feldon finds the first of his canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

events.summary: Argoth Forest is ravaged during the rule of the artificers, and its Pixies turn their magic to practical ends.
events.quote: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers

events.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia itself a casualty of war.
events.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war

events.summary: Gaea instills a portion of her power into vengeful followers after Argoth's destruction.
events.quote: Gaea was willing to instill a portion of her own powers into some of her more vengeful followers.

events.summary: A handful of peasant-pikemen hold off three Craw Wurms at the Battle of Sarinth.
events.quote: a handful of peasant-pikemen held off a trio of rampaging Craw Wurms
By the time Mishra was defeated

Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant.

relations.note: The people of Kroog were among his first allies.
relations.quote: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog.
